en.name: Plum sauce
en.summary: Plum sauce is a sugar-and-vinegar fruit preserve — sweet, acidic and thick, the same combination that makes a jam shelf-stable. Unopened it keeps about 18–24 months in a cool dark cupboard. Once opened, refrigerate it and use it within about 3–6 months.
en.pantry: Unopened jars and bottles keep to the printed date in a cool dark cupboard, about 18–24 months from purchase. That range is borrowed from hoisin sauce, the closest sweet Chinese jar sauce with a published figure; no agency publishes one for plum sauce itself. Keep it upright, away from the hob and out of sunlight, and do not keep a jar that has lost its vacuum or is weeping sticky sauce down the outside.
en.fridge: Refrigerate after opening at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within about 3–6 months. Any darkening at the neck of the jar is oxidation and not a problem in itself. Use a clean dry spoon each time, and wipe the rim before closing — a sugary sauce crusts into the thread and makes the lid hard to seat. Never brush from the jar onto raw meat and then dip back in.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for plum sauce and no real need for one: sugar and vinegar already keep it for months in the fridge, comfortably longer than most households take to finish a jar. Freezing would separate it and dull the gloss that makes it work as a dipping sauce. Buy the jar size that matches how often you eat duck pancakes or spring rolls.
spoilage: Fuzzy mould on the surface — in a high-sugar food it can be growing deeper than it looks, so the whole jar goes
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
A domed lid, or fizzing when the jar is opened
Liquid separating out with a dull, darkened colour
tips: Use a clean dry spoon and wipe the rim before closing.
Decant what you need into a dipping dish rather than serving from the jar.
Write the opening date on the lid.
Keep the jar out of sunlight; light darkens a fruit sauce quickly.

faq.q: Does plum sauce need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Yes. Refrigerate at 4 °C or below and use within about 3–6 months.

faq.q: How long does unopened plum sauce last?
faq.a: About 18–24 months in a cool dark cupboard. That range is borrowed from hoisin sauce; no agency publishes one for plum sauce.

faq.q: Can you scrape mould off plum sauce?
faq.a: No. Mould in a high-sugar sauce can be growing deeper than it looks. Discard the jar.
There is no timeline and no need. It keeps for months refrigerated and freezing separates it.

zh.name: 蘇梅醬
zh.summary: 蘇梅醬是糖加醋的水果保存品——甜、酸、濃稠，正是讓果醬能常溫存放的那個組合。未開封放陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 18～24 個月。開封後請冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。
zh.pantry: 未開封的玻璃罐和瓶裝放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，到標示日期為止，從購買日起算大約 18～24 個月。這個範圍借自海鮮醬，那是資料中最接近的中式甜味瓶醬且有公布數字；蘇梅醬本身沒有機構公布過期限。請直立擺放、遠離爐火、避免日曬；已經沒有真空感，或瓶身外側滲出黏稠醬汁的就不要留。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。瓶口附近顏色變深是氧化，本身不是問題。每次都用乾淨乾燥的湯匙，蓋回去前先擦瓶口——含糖的醬會在螺紋上結硬殼，讓蓋子蓋不平。也絕對不要拿它刷過生肉之後又伸回罐子裡。
zh.freezer: 蘇梅醬沒有冷凍期限，實際上也不需要：糖和醋已經讓它在冰箱裡放好幾個月，比多數家庭用完一罐的時間還長。冷凍會讓它分離，也會失去當沾醬時那層漂亮的光澤。請依你吃烤鴨捲餅或春捲的頻率選罐子大小。
spoilage: 醬面長出毛狀的霉——高糖食物裡的霉往往比看起來更深，整罐都要丟
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
蓋子鼓起，或開罐時冒氣
分離出液體，顏色變得暗沉
tips: 用乾淨乾燥的湯匙，蓋回去前擦瓶口。
把要用的量倒到沾醬碟，不要直接從罐子上桌。
避免日曬；光會讓果醬類很快變深。

faq.a: 要。放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。

faq.q: 未開封的蘇梅醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 18～24 個月。這個範圍借自海鮮醬，蘇梅醬本身沒有公布數字。

faq.q: 蘇梅醬長霉可以挖掉嗎？
faq.a: 不行。高糖醬料裡的霉可能長得比看起來更深。整罐丟掉。
沒有對應期限，也沒有必要。它冷藏就能放好幾個月，冷凍反而會分離。
